questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: A relation in BCNF is always in which normal forms?
questions.explanation: BCNF is stricter than 3NF, so lower normal forms are satisfied.
questions.shortcut: Higher normal form implies all lower forms.

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: Which ACID properties are guaranteed by strict two-phase locking?
questions.explanation: 2PL enforces serializability (isolation). Atomicity/consistency are transaction manager guarantees; durability needs logging/storage.

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: If a B+ tree has fanout 100, minimum height required to index 1,000,000 keys?
questions.explanation: 100^3 = 1,000,000 so height 3 (root to leaves levels depending convention).
questions.shortcut: Use log base fanout of key count.

questions.subject: DBMS
questions.question: Which SQL clause is evaluated after GROUP BY?
questions.explanation: HAVING filters grouped rows after aggregation.
questions.shortcut: WHERE before grouping, HAVING after grouping.
